description_en: Lists all deployed stress testing tasks
description_zh: 查看当前用户部署的所有压测任务
name: ListBenchmarkTask

parameters.help_en: The filter used to query tasks. If you specify this parameter, the system returns tasks whose names or associated service names match the filter value
parameters.help_zh: 过滤参数。如果指定，将分别查找EAS服务名和压测任务名中和指定参数匹配的记录
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The name of the EAS service that corresponds to the stress testing task. For more information about how to query the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 压测任务对应的EAS服务名称。如何查询服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 压测任务列表的页码。起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The name of the Elastic Algorithm Service (EAS) service that corresponds to the stress testing task. For more information about how to query the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的压测任务数量，默认为100
parameters.name: page_size
